question: Which of the following is a professional table tennis player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manika Batra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manika Batra** is a **professional table tennis player** who has won several medals for India at** international events.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parupalli Kashyap** is a well-known badminton player who has won the** gold medal** at the 2014 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow, Scotland.
 
• **Aparna Popat** is a former badminton player who has won the** bronze medal** at the 1998 Commonwealth Games held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
• **Saurav Ghosal** is a professional **squash player **who has won the** gold medal** at the 2014 Asian Games held in Incheon, South Korea.
